parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const required=['niche','location','message','allowedStart','allowedEnd']; if(required.some(k=>typeof b[k]!=='string'||!b[k].trim())) throw new Error('VALIDATION_ERROR'); const time=/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/; if(!time.test(b.allowedStart)||!time.test(b.allowedEnd)) throw new Error('INVALID_ALLOWED_HOURS'); const requested=Number(b.maximumContacts??10); if(!Number.isInteger(requested)||requested<1) throw new Error('INVALID_MAXIMUM_CONTACTS'); const minimum=Number(b.minimumDelaySeconds??90), maximum=Number(b.maximumDelaySeconds??240); if(!Number.isInteger(minimum)||minimum<90) throw new Error('MIN_DELAY_90'); if(!Number.isInteger(maximum)||minimum>maximum||maximum>3600) throw new Error('INVALID_DELAY'); const mode=b.executionMode??'approval'; if(!['approval','automatic'].includes(mode)) throw new Error('INVALID_EXECUTION_MODE'); const max=Math.min(requested,20); const slug=s=>s.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'').slice(0,80); const searches=[b.niche,`${b.niche} ${b.location}`,b.state?`${b.niche} ${b.state}`:null,`#${slug(b.niche)}`,`#${slug(b.niche+b.location)}`,...(Array.isArray(b.additionalTerms)?b.additionalTerms:[])].filter(Boolean); return [{json:{...b,niche:b.niche.trim(),location:b.location.trim(),maximumContacts:max,minimumDelaySeconds:minimum,maximumDelaySeconds:maximum,executionMode:mode,dryRun:b.dryRun!==false,additionalTerms:Array.isArray(b.additionalTerms)?b.additionalTerms:[],excludedKeywords:Array.isArray(b.excludedKeywords)?b.excludedKeywords:[],ignoredProfiles:Array.isArray(b.ignoredProfiles)?b.ignoredProfiles:[],searchQueries:[...new Set(searches)]}}];

parameters.jsCode: const cfg=$('Validate and Build Searches').first().json; return cfg.searchQueries.map(query=>({json:{query,maximumProfiles:cfg.maximumContacts}}));

const runs=$('Search Instagram').all(); const intervention=runs.find(i=>i.json.status==='platform_intervention_required'); if(intervention) throw new Error('PLATFORM_INTERVENTION_REQUIRED: '+(intervention.json.reason||'manual action required')); const cfg=$('Validate and Build Searches').first().json; const all=runs.flatMap(i=>i.json.profiles??[]).filter(p=>p?.username&&p?.profileUrl); const unique=[...new Map(all.map(p=>[p.username.toLowerCase(),p])).values()].slice(0,cfg.maximumContacts); if(!unique.length) return [{json:{username:'',profileUrl:'',profilesFound:0,noProfiles:true},pairedItem:{item:0}}]; return unique.map(p=>({json:{...p,profilesFound:unique.length,noProfiles:false},pairedItem:{item:0}}));

parameters.query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prospects WHERE lower(username)=lower($1) OR profile_url=$2) AS seen, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM blocklist WHERE lower(username)=lower($1) OR profile_url=$2) AS blocked

parameters.jsCode: const profile=$('Loop Profiles').item.json; const cfg=$('Validate and Build Searches').first().json; const ignored=cfg.ignoredProfiles.map(value=>String(value).toLowerCase()); const eligible=profile.noProfiles!==true && $json.seen!==true && $json.blocked!==true && !ignored.includes(String(profile.username).toLowerCase()) && !ignored.includes(String(profile.profileUrl).toLowerCase()); return [{json:{...profile,seen:$json.seen===true,blocked:$json.blocked===true,eligible},pairedItem:{item:0}}];

parameters.query: WITH upserted AS (INSERT INTO prospects(username,display_name,profile_url,biography,followers_text,detected_category,detected_location,qualification_score,qualification_status) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9::qualification_status) ON CONFLICT(profile_url) DO UPDATE SET display_name=EXCLUDED.display_name,biography=EXCLUDED.biography,followers_text=EXCLUDED.followers_text,detected_category=EXCLUDED.detected_category,detected_location=EXCLUDED.detected_location,qualification_score=EXCLUDED.qualification_score,qualification_status=EXCLUDED.qualification_status,last_seen_at=now() RETURNING id), counted AS (UPDATE executions SET profiles_analyzed=profiles_analyzed+1,profiles_qualified=profiles_qualified+CASE WHEN $9='qualified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,messages_skipped=messages_skipped+CASE WHEN $9='qualified' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END WHERE id=$10) SELECT id FROM upserted

parameters.jsCode: const cfg=$('Validate and Build Searches').first().json; const profile=$('Guard Analysis').item.json.profile; let message=cfg.message.replace(/{{displayName}}/g,profile.displayName?.trim()||'').replace(/{{username}}/g,profile.username).replace(/{{niche}}/g,cfg.niche).replace(/{{location}}/g,cfg.location).replace(/\s+([,.!?])/g,'$1').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); if(!profile.displayName) message=message.replace(/^(olá|oi)[, ]*[.!-]?\s*/i,''); if(!message) throw new Error('EMPTY_MESSAGE'); return [{json:{profileUrl:profile.profileUrl,message:message.slice(0,900),executionId:$('Create Execution').first().json.id,prospectId:$json.id,dryRun:cfg.dryRun,mode:cfg.executionMode}}];

const cfg=$('Validate and Build Searches').first().json; const parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB',{timeZone:'America/Sao_Paulo',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hourCycle:'h23'}).formatToParts(new Date()); const now=parts.find(p=>p.type==='hour').value+':'+parts.find(p=>p.type==='minute').value; const inside=cfg.allowedStart<=cfg.allowedEnd ? now>=cfg.allowedStart&&now<=cfg.allowedEnd : now>=cfg.allowedStart||now<=cfg.allowedEnd; if(!inside) throw new Error(`OUTSIDE_ALLOWED_HOURS: ${now}`); return $input.all();

parameters.query: INSERT INTO outreach_messages(campaign_id,prospect_id,execution_id,message,status,prepared_at,sent_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,CASE WHEN $5='prepared' THEN now() END,CASE WHEN $5='sent' THEN now() END) ON CONFLICT(campaign_id,prospect_id) DO UPDATE SET message=EXCLUDED.message,status=EXCLUDED.status,prepared_at=EXCLUDED.prepared_at,sent_at=EXCLUDED.sent_at RETURNING id,status

UPDATE executions SET messages_prepared=messages_prepared+CASE WHEN $2='prepared' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,messages_sent=messages_sent+CASE WHEN $2='sent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,messages_skipped=messages_skipped+CASE WHEN $2 NOT IN ('prepared','sent') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id=$1 RETURNING id

WITH updated AS (UPDATE executions e SET profiles_found=$1,status=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outreach_messages o WHERE o.execution_id=e.id AND o.status='prepared') THEN 'awaiting_approval' ELSE 'completed' END,finished_at=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outreach_messages o WHERE o.execution_id=e.id AND o.status='prepared') THEN NULL ELSE now() END WHERE e.id=$2 RETURNING e.*) SELECT u.id,u.status,u.profiles_found,u.profiles_analyzed,u.profiles_qualified,u.messages_prepared,u.messages_sent,u.messages_skipped,u.started_at,u.finished_at,COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('outreachMessageId',o.id,'approvalToken',o.id,'profileUrl',p.profile_url,'message',o.message)) FROM outreach_messages o JOIN prospects p ON p.id=o.prospect_id WHERE o.execution_id=u.id AND o.status='prepared'),'[]'::json) AS approvals FROM updated u
